architecture.systemPurpose: A field sales and visit management Progressive Web App (PWA) that enables sales representatives to manage outlet visits, track consignment inventory cycles, and calculate product production costs (HPP) while operating reliably in offline conditions. The system synchronizes visit data, GPS-validated check-ins, and consignment reconciliations between field devices and a Cloudflare-hosted backend.
architecture.architectureStyle: Layered architecture with clear client-server separation: Svelte-based PWA frontend with service-oriented backend on Cloudflare Workers. The frontend uses a presentation-service-utility layering with localStorage for offline draft persistence, while the backend employs route-service-repository layering over Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) with Drizzle ORM. This separation supports offline-first field operations while maintaining centralized data consistency.

architecture.dataFlow: Offline-capable flow: User interacts with Svelte UI → client-side services manage state and drafts in localStorage → GPS/photo capture via browser APIs → ApiClient syncs to backend when online → Cloudflare Worker routes authenticate via SessionService → RbacService authorizes via capability checks → domain services (VisitProcessingService, HPPService) execute business logic with idempotency → DatabaseClientFactory persists to Cloudflare D1 via Drizzle ORM; media files flow through PhotoService compression to storage
integrations: Cloudflare R2 or compatible object storage (media/photos)
architecture.securityModel: Session-based authentication with stateless session tokens (SessionService createSession/optionalAuth) issued at login via POST /api/auth/login; PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing with timing-safe comparison (PasswordService); RBAC authorization via static role-permission matrix with Capability-based checks enforced by Hono middleware (RbacService); route-level authentication required on all /api/* endpoints with optional auth for specific routes; geofence validation with owner-role override capability for visit submissions
keyDecisions: Progressive Web App architecture with Svelte frontend for offline-capable field operations with localStorage draft persistence
Cloudflare Worker edge deployment for low-latency API access from distributed field locations
Drizzle ORM with DatabaseClientFactory for type-safe D1 SQLite operations in serverless environment
Idempotency keys on visit processing and void operations to prevent duplicate consignment transactions in unreliable network conditions
HPP (Harga Pokok Produksi) service with cascade recalculation triggered by raw material cost changes, supporting recipe-based product costing
Geofence validation with optional owner override for visit submissions, balancing operational flexibility with location accountability
Static role-capability matrix in RbacService rather than dynamic permission storage, simplifying authorization in edge environment
Client-side photo compression before upload to reduce bandwidth usage in field conditions
Separate VisitDraft (localStorage) and VisitSubmission (server-persisted) entities to support offline-first workflow with eventual synchronization
